    Fixed tree shapes for cleaving diagrams #

    • RayCat.isAcyclic_of_parent: a graph whose edges are exactly the pairs {a, par a} for a parent function lowering a height is a forest.
    • RayCat.D5: the D̃₅ shape of BO13a Lemma 5 a) (case i − 1 = 1), and RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_d5.
